approval_evidence.quote: 10/22/2021 ORIG-1 Approval (Drugs@FDA, Original Approvals or Tentative Approvals)

series_start_reason: Roche's FY2021 release (3 Feb 2022, 220203_ir_fy21_en.pdf) prints the first Susvimo sales (full year 1, all United States); the nine-month 2021 release (211020_ir_q3_en.pdf) has no Susvimo row, and FDA approval was 22 Oct 2021, so the full-year figure is read as 2021Q4. This is an inference from the absence of an earlier row.
notes: Printed line is 'Susvimo'; worldwide Total column (all United States in every release read, regional columns are separate). Roche prints it in the year-to-date product sales table only, never in the quarterly Top 20 table, so Q1 of each year is the three-month table and Q2-Q4 are year-to-date differences of figures that Roche rounds to whole CHF millions; quarterly values are therefore accurate to about plus or minus 1. 2022Q4 is negative because the FY2022 release prints full year 2 against nine months 3 printed in the Q3 2022 release; no Roche document read explains the decrease. launch_quarter is null: no Roche document read states a launch quarter (FDA approval 22 Oct 2021).
search_log: reused the Roche crawl already on disk from earlier batches (roche.com/investors/events/{q1,hy,q3,annual-results}-YYYY and dated assets.cwp.roche.com/imported/en/med-cor-YYYY-MM-DD-e.pdf probes); 63 Roche results releases from the FY2010 release (2011-02-02) to the half-year 2026 release (2026-07-23) were read as text

per release read the year-to-date Pharmaceuticals Division product sales table (Total, United States, Europe, Japan, International) and, where the product is in it, the five-column worldwide Top 20 quarterly table; quarters taken from the Q1 three-month table or by year-to-date differences within consecutive Roche releases
for every calendar year in the series the four quarters sum to the full-year (January-December) figure of that year's FY release
Roche half-year and annual reports (finance reports) and the 2009-2010 results releases were not used for quarterly rows
Susvimo absence before 2021Q4: 211020_ir_q3_en.pdf (nine-month 2021) and the earlier 2021 releases contain no Susvimo sales row
